note: Forbidden: splitting the area's links over several router-LSAs, or omitting one. Red: TestRFC2328SingleRouterLSACarriesEveryLink fails unless exactly one router-LSA from 1.1.1.1 exists in the area and its body holds a transit link for each of the two interfaces. Other polarity: TestRFC2328RouterLSAExcludesOtherAreaLinks fails if an interface of area 0.0.0.1 is described in the backbone router-LSA, so 'links to the area' is bounded. One clause, both polarities.
